decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason (Condition 5)

The details submitted pursuant to condition 5 (external plant) of planning permission 00657/P/P13 dated 1 July 2010; for 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use), are considered to meet the requirements of the condition and relevant policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-P.1.5 (Noise Pollution) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan; subject to the addition of the following condition:

(5)(i) All external plant shall be sited, so far as practicable, so as to minimise its effect on the appearance of the building; and noise emitted from any plant shall not be less than 10dB below the background noise level, as measured at 1 metre from the window of a habitable room in the fa?ade of any neighbouring residential property (in accordance with BS 4142).

Reason: In the interest of the visual amenity of the area and the living conditions of neighbours and residents.

Reason (Condition 9)

The details submitted pursuant to condition 9 (waste and recycling) of planning permission 00657/P/P13 dated 1 July 2010; for 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use), are considered to meet the requirements of the condition and relevant policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-P.2.4 (Recycling Facilities in New Developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
